This '''Gamorrean farmer''' was working on her farm when [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] arrived on a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling run]].

==Biography==
During the reign of [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], this Gamorrean farmer was living on [[Gamorr/Legends|Gamorr]] and tending her farm. The crime leader [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] sent his two favorite smugglers, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] to Gamorr to pick up more guards. Their primary point of contact was this farmer, and they required a [[TC-72|translator]] to negotiate. When the smugglers landed, Solo made the mistake of assuming the farmer was male, and insulted her. She was about to kill him when TC-72 apologized on behalf of the uncouth smuggler. After more negotiations, the two smugglers departed with the guards and a package of [[Snoruuk/Legends|snoruuks]].

==Personality and traits==
As a typical Gamorrean sow, she tended the farm. During a conversation with Han Solo, she took affront to his comics and would have killed him if it weren't for a last-second translation by the droid.
